[2026-10-28 02:27 CET] Accepted models through native initialization, narrowing and callback restart. Published formalize ee66ac13fbda4ffd52636dc96654d9ff68ee7c01; source cfad1652ff20cc20bf0537c26591fb686b5e2821.

An original accepted native term now supplies the literal startup model. Under three explicit sufficient original annotation/symbol policies, the actual selected prefix preserves the SAME assignment in its attached parked or narrowed cache. Existing Read.exact supplies full Mu/Union language coverage. No accepting returned-row or future model premise is added. An accepted selected head also carries its SAME extended model into the actual framed callback restart cache, under the original pending refutation, template avoidance and per-program encoding conditions. Non-rejection, returned pending refutation and the exact summed-fuel continuation equation remain. Complete old startup (1485 B), canonical-prefix (2466 B) and head/callback (16289 B) declarations recover literally. Original producers run once; bounds precede semantic models.

DONE means no expandable candidates. Valid retained SOME pending handles can be recursive boundaries with empty buckets. Original boundary-root startup supplies a full Packet, ProperState and carriers, yet is NOT Discharged. Its actual run emits a singleton at the SAME cache/caller/query for every fuel, and native rendering returns the explicit marker. This is an original-admission family, not an instantiated physical Context or a public Haskell execution. The inspected Haskell marker and partial TruncatedRecursion paths support intentional opacity. No new Haskell defect or fix is established. No Haskell/Cabal edits, tests or benchmarks ran. FINDINGS retains the integrated LPO/KBO repairs and external-review boundary.

Six modules add 14 public theorems. Seven final strict checks pass. Full Audit: 4331 jobs, 80527 theorem dependencies. Public readback: 323 blocks and nine definitions, 1292203 B, SHA256 d69e320cb852a354647a64dec18fd3aaa5da747cf84793bc085d6bf8dee6d25c. The entire prior 1213984 B remains an exact prefix; the new appendix is 78219 B. Only three standard axioms. All 4324 old non-Audit Lean sources, 173 pinned strong modules and 810 tracked Haskell source/evidence files retain bytes. All 14 current compiler/build/public commands and four failures remain. Compiler work was serial with measured 4 GiB and zero swap. Three reviews are sealed. Portable and committed evidence passes: 880 payloads, 187 archives, 359 source records. Manifest: 0435459e7d48167a7b145a81af217924519ae523ea16e83add898fd463394723. Nine whole older status bodies are inverse-preserved.

The largest gap is global ORIGINAL accepted-model preservation and output coverage under permitted policies, including intended opaque/truncated recursive outputs. Do not require every DONE output to be Discharged. The previous conditional concrete-render theorem remains valid. Selected-variable program positions, public typing/template origins, public APIs, ranking/sampling and physical Haskell correspondence remain open. A parked model alone does not prove continuation or output existence. Whole-CFTA correctness remains the objective. Goal ACTIVE; checkpoint PROGRESS.
